content: STAGE 1: goal - orient in the repo and inventory existing mechanisms so the proposal is genuinely new. Read: workspace listing and results/research dirs for issue126 / 121. Observed: (filling below). Open: which coupling positions are untried.

STAGE 2: goal - deliverable. Read: the evidence digest in the prompt (issue126/121 measurements: four-point condition non-discriminative, curvature is a gauge, behaviour-contrast metrics predict recall, Gromov/ancestor weighting hurt) and the list of rejected earlier-round mechanisms (successor-weighted Frechet codebook, prefix-level curvature, radial behaviour assignment, successor profile smoothing, cone constraints, curvature-shifted boosting). Observed: the untried position is the metric tensor itself rather than weights, radii, updates or curvature values. Reasoned: elder copies of transition weighting all re-weight pairs or scale radius; fixing c=1 and letting a degree-corrected successor-concentration scalar act as a conformal factor inside a single Lorentz arccosh product is a distinct, cheap, single-path coupling with a natural behaviour-off (g=1) and geometry-off (Euclidean) switch. Produced CONFORMAL-SUCC-RQ, full spec, cost 786k arccosh per step, one run, no tuning (all constants frozen from the training split or documented unit conventions). Open: nothing blocking; implementation would need the Lorentz clamp and the per-epoch g aggregation only.

STAGE 3 (final): produced CONFORMAL-SUCC-RQ. Behaviour signal: degree-corrected successor concentration b_i=clip(z(log(q_i*d_i)),-2,2), q_i=sum_j P_ij^2 from train-only directed transitions. Geometry: fixed c=1 Lorentz arccosh distance, no curvature estimation (gauge respected). Coupling: per-level conformal weight g_{l,k}=sum_i w_ik exp(b_i/4)/sum_i w_ik multiplies the Lorentz distance inside the RQ assignment logit s_ik=-(g_{l,k}*d_L)^2/tau_l, tau_l=mean_k||e_lk||^2. Switches: behaviour-off g=1; geometry-off Euclidean tangent distance in the same product; only both-on trained. Cost ~786k arccosh per step, <1% of a transformer step; no extra parameters beyond the frozen 24556-vector b. Observables: behaviour-weighted quantization error by b-tercile, prefix transition entropy, code usage perplexity, Stage3 test_recall@10 vs 0.065.
